description: Check whether a salary meets the federal $684 per week level for the white-collar overtime exemptions and a state threshold you enter. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

bonus.description: Nondiscretionary bonuses and commissions per year (US dollars). Paid at least annually. These count toward up to 10% of the federal level only.

federal.description: Federal standard salary level per week (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for federal standard salary level per week. Unknown is not the same as zero. Official reference value 684 USD from Federal Register 2026-09839 (29 CFR 541.600 restored), effective 2026-05-15. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

hce.description: Federal highly compensated employee total annual compensation (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for federal highly compensated employee total annual compensation. Unknown is not the same as zero. Official reference value 107432 USD from Federal Register 2026-09839 (29 CFR 541.600 restored), effective 2026-05-15. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

period.description: Pay period. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for pay period. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: 52 = Weekly; 26 = Every two weeks; 24 = Twice a month; 12 = Monthly; 1 = Yearly.

salary.description: Salary per pay period (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for salary per pay period. Unknown is not the same as zero.

state.description: State annual salary threshold (your figure; 0 if none) (US dollars). Some states set a higher threshold, often a multiple of the state minimum wage. Use your state labor department’s current figure.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

name: buscalc_exempt_salary_threshold_test

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.
